notes: Read all 540 line-numbered source lines before editing; every line was considered. The web file is the Redis Signal Viewer admin page: pick a vehicle, free-text + category filter, a 5s auto-refresh toggle, refresh + two destructive purge buttons, a meta-chip row, four stat cards, a sortable/paginated DataTable whose Value column masks lat/lng location signals, a branch-aware RedisDiagnosticEmptyState, and a dual-mode ConfirmDialog (per-vehicle danger-confirm + cluster-wide typed 'PURGE ALL' confirm). The native port preserves the contract 1:1 using React Native primitives + the existing native AppText/GlassPanel + tokens and the already-ported native ConfirmDialog / devtools client / useVehicles hook, with browser-only deps reduced and documented below.

The web docs CTA <a href={ctaHref}> wrapping a Button (internal SPA route /docs/caching) is reduced to an accessible no-navigation Button (no native router/docs target), documented here.

Native control stand-ins (local native-safe ports): Select = a wrap row of Pressable option chips (accessibilityRole='button', accessibilityState selected) calling onValueChange(opt.value) — the SignalQueryControls/FleetAPIPage per-page-selector precedent; the web dropdown's enumerated options render inline. Input = a TextInput (autoCapitalize/autoCorrect off). Toggle = a Pressable switch (accessibilityRole='switch', onPress=onChange(!checked)) with a translateX thumb; web cyan-500 'on' / gray-600 'off'. Button = a Pressable (secondary/danger) with token surfaces + a disabled 0.4 opacity. Badge = a rounded chip View+AppText keyed by a success/info/warning/danger/neutral colour map (the web green/blue/yellow/red/gray dark-mode shades). StatCard = a bordered card (label eyebrow + optional icon + large value). Skeleton = a token-backed box. EmptyState = a centred glyph + muted message. MaskedValue = a monospace masked/revealed AppText (maskCoords ported: '<lat>,<lng>' -> '••.•••, ••.•••', lone number -> '••.•••', non-numeric -> a length-preserving bullet run) + a reveal/hide Pressable with the verbatim 30s auto-hide timer (cleared on unmount); auditOnReveal POST /audit/reveal and clipboard copy are unavailable on native so auditOnReveal is a no-op and the copy affordance is omitted (no Clipboard dependency). DataTable = a header row (sortable headers are Pressable -> onSort(key) with a ▲/▼ indicator) + caller-ordered data rows (testID admin:redis-signals-row-<name>) + a data.length>pageSize prev/next pager (pageSize 50). useSortToggle reproduces the web controlled-sort state (toggle dir on same key, else set key + desc).

No DOM-only modules, browser HTML elements (div/span/h1/select/button/code/a/dl/dt/dd), window/document, react-i18next, lucide-react, @/components/layout|motion|feedback|data-display|ui, Recharts, or Leaflet appear in the native output — only React, react-native primitives (Alert/Pressable/ScrollView/StyleSheet/TextInput/View), the native AppText/GlassPanel + tokens, the native ConfirmDialog, the native devtools client (getRedisSignals/purgeRedisSignals/purgeAllRedisSignals/getRedisSignalKeys + RedisSignalEntry/RedisSignalKeyEntry/RedisSignalsMeta), the native useVehicles hook, and the native client (ApiError/isApiError) + @tanstack/react-query. Explicit unavailable browser behaviour: document.title -> no-op; the in-house Toast queue -> Alert.alert; MaskedValue audit POST + clipboard copy -> unavailable (no-op/omitted); the docs-link CTA -> no-navigation Button. A companion __tests__/RedisSignalViewerPage.test.tsx (7 tests, useQuery/useQueryClient + useVehicles + devtools mocked synchronously like the FleetAPIPage/ApiPlaygroundPage precedent, Alert spied) exercises the scaffold title/subtitle + select-prompt gating, the select->stat-cards+meta-chips+table reveal, the search filter, the category filter, the mode-local diagnostic banner, the per-vehicle purge dialog + purgeRedisSignals(1) confirm, and the cluster-wide typed-confirmation dialog.
